info.description: FedRAG analyses Federal Reserve (FOMC) communications: it answers questions with retrieval-augmented generation grounded in cited statements and minutes, classifies each meeting's policy stance as hawkish, neutral or dovish, compares two statements sentence by sentence, and benchmarks the retrieval strategies behind it. Endpoints backed by Postgres return 503 while DATABASE_URL is not set or the database cannot be reached, Ask the Fed returns 503 until OPENAI_API_KEY is set and the search index is built (make index), and the evaluation returns 503 until make rag-eval has written data/eval/rag_benchmark.json. On the public demo (PUBLIC_DEMO=true; GET /api/health reports demo_mode) nothing calls OpenAI: Ask the Fed returns 403 and GET /api/ask/examples serves recorded answers instead, and comparisons serve stored analyses only (analysis_status "disabled_on_demo" otherwise).
info.title: FedRAG API

post.description:
Answer a question from retrieved FOMC passages, citing the ones the answer relies on.

With `as_of` only documents released by then are searched, and the model is told to answer as
of that date. Each `[n]` marker in the answer refers to `citations[n - 1]`. Disabled (403) on
the public demo, after request validation.

403.description: Disabled on the public demo (PUBLIC_DEMO=true), which makes no OpenAI calls; GET /api/ask/examples serves recorded answers instead.

502.description: The OpenAI request failed: network error, rate limit, no credit left on the OpenAI account, or bad key.

503.description: LLM not configured (OPENAI_API_KEY is not set), the search index not built yet (run make index), or the reranker model unavailable.

post.summary: Ask a question about FOMC communications

get.description:
Real answers of the production configuration (hybrid + rerank under the tuned retriever
preset), recorded during the RAG evaluation, each with its citations, the question's
evaluation id and the evaluation judge's verdicts.

Read from data/eval/ask_examples.json (make ask-examples); serving them calls no LLM, so they
are available in every mode, including the public demo, where they stand in for live
answers.

503.description: The example answers have not been exported (make ask-examples), or their file does not fit the contract.

post.description:
Answer like POST /api/ask, streaming the answer as server-sent events.

A missing key, index or reranker is an HTTP error before the stream starts, as for /api/ask,
and so is the public demo's 403. The `done` event carries the same AskResponse that /api/ask
returns. If the client disconnects, generation stops.

200.description: A text/event-stream; each event is `event: <name>` and `data: <JSON>`. In order: `status` (StreamStatus) when retrieval starts and again when generation starts; then `delta` (StreamDelta), the next piece of the answer with final citation numbers, each passage's first citation preceded by `citation` (StreamCitation); last `done` (AskResponse), the final answer that replaces the streamed text. A failure after the stream started ends it with `error` (StreamError) instead of `done`. Comment lines (`: ping`) keep an idle connection open. The schema is the union of the data payloads.

403.description: Disabled on the public demo (PUBLIC_DEMO=true), which makes no OpenAI calls; GET /api/ask/examples serves recorded answers instead.

503.description: LLM not configured (OPENAI_API_KEY is not set), the search index not built yet (run make index), or the reranker model unavailable.

post.summary: Ask a question and stream the answer as it is written

post.description:
Sentence-level diff of the FOMC statements of two meetings, looked up by meeting date,
with an LLM reading of what the changed wording signals and each statement's stored stance.

The diff is deterministic and needs no LLM: sentences are aligned in order, each item is
unchanged, modified (with a word-level diff), added or removed, and ids index `changes`.
The analysis reads only the changed items and the target statement, as of the target's
release date; it is stored per pair, so `analysis="generate"` normally pays for one LLM call
per pair (a second when the first reply cannot be parsed); a failed generation is not
stored, so asking again pays again. Without OPENAI_API_KEY the diff is still returned
(analysis_status llm_not_configured, unless an analysis is already stored). The public demo
never writes one: there the status of a pair without a stored analysis is disabled_on_demo.

404.description: No FOMC statement for a meeting on base_date or target_date; the message names the nearest statement dates.

503.description: Database not configured (DATABASE_URL is not set), not reachable, or not loaded yet (run make db-load).

get.description:
Retrieval and answer quality of BM25, dense, hybrid and hybrid + rerank retrieval under
each retriever config, on the evaluation question set.

Retrieval: chunk-level recall@5/@10, MRR@10 and graded nDCG@10, document-level recall, per
question type and split, and latency. Answers (the production chain of POST /api/ask), scored
by an LLM judge: faithfulness, citation accuracy, answer correctness, refusals. Means come
with percentile bootstrap intervals over questions, and paired intervals for differences
between runs. Every question is listed with its outcome per run; GET
/api/evaluation/questions/{question_id} has the passages and answers. Read from
data/eval/rag_benchmark.json (make rag-eval); serving it calls no LLM.

503.description: The evaluation has not been run yet (run make rag-eval), or its file does not fit the contract.

get.description:
One question of the evaluation: its labels, the gold passages, and under each run the top
retrieved passages with hit markers, the answer, and the judge's verdicts on its claims,
citations, required facts and refusal.

Passage text comes from the local search index; without one (make index) the ids and
markers are still returned, with `passages_available` false.

404.description: No question with that id in the evaluation.

503.description: The evaluation has not been run yet (run make rag-eval), or its file does not fit the contract.

get.description:
Report the backend version, whether the LLM, database and vector store are set up, and
whether this is the public demo, where every feature that would call OpenAI is off.

List FOMC meetings in date order and the document types collected for each.

With `as_of` the list is the point-in-time view on that date: later meetings are left out and
so are documents released after it, such as minutes that came out weeks after the meeting.
